items.title: Openstack-network-exporter: http.server has no readheadertimeout / readtimeout (slowloris)
items.summary: A flaw was found in openstack-network-exporter. The HTTP server within the component is configured without essential timeout settings, such as ReadHeaderTimeout. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to initiate multiple slow HTTP header connections. By trickling header bytes, the attacker can exhaust server resources, specifically file descriptors, leading to a Denial of Service (DoS) that…

items.title: Openstack-network-exporter: basic-auth uses plaintext password storage and non-constant-time comparison
items.summary: A flaw was found in openstack-network-exporter. When an operator configures user authentication but omits or misconfigures Transport Layer Security (TLS), the basic authentication mechanism is silently bypassed. This fail-open design allows an adjacent network attacker to access sensitive Open vSwitch (OVS) and Open Virtual Network (OVN) dataplane metrics without credentials. Consequently, an attacker can enumerate…

items.title: browser-use SecurityWatchdog config.py load and migrate config improper authorization
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in browser-use 0.13.13/0.13.14. This impacts the function load and migrate config of the file browser use/config.py of the component SecurityWatchdog. The manipulation results in improper authorization. The attack requires a local approach. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: Keycloak: keycloak: information disclosure via improper role enforcement in uma 2.0 protection api
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. The User-Managed Access (UMA) 2.0 Protection API endpoint for permission tickets fails to enforce the uma protection role check. This allows any authenticated user with a token issued for a resource server client, even without the uma protection role, to enumerate all permission tickets in the system. This vulnerability partial leads to information disclosure.

items.title: Keycloak: org.keycloak/keycloak-services: keycloak: privilege escalation via manage-clients permission
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. An administrator with manage-clients permission can exploit a misconfiguration where this permission is equivalent to manage-permissions . This allows the administrator to escalate privileges and gain control over roles, users, or other administrative functions within the realm. This privilege escalation can occur when admin permissions are enabled at the realm level.

items.title: Keycloak: keycloak: denial of service due to excessive samlrequest decompression
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. An unauthenticated remote attacker can trigger an application level Denial of Service (DoS) by sending a highly compressed SAMLRequest through the SAML Redirect Binding. The server fails to enforce size limits during DEFLATE decompression, leading to an OutOfMemoryError (OOM) and subsequent process termination. This vulnerability allows an attacker to disrupt the availability of the…

items.title: Org.keycloak/keycloak-services: keycloak: unauthorized modification of unmanaged user attributes by administrators
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. An administrator with manage-users permission can bypass the "Only administrators can view" setting for unmanaged attributes, allowing them to modify these attributes. This improper access control can lead to unauthorized changes to user profiles, even when the system is configured to restrict such modifications.

items.title: Jboss enterprise application platform: jboss eap: jbeap: jboss enterprise application platform: unauthorized ejb access via authorization module bypass
items.summary: A flaw was found in JBoss Enterprise Application Platform. When role-based authorization is used for Enterprise Java Beans (EJB) access, the system does not correctly call the necessary authorization modules. This prevents Java Authorization Contract for Containers (JACC) permissions from being applied, allowing remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to EJBs.

items.title: Jboss enterprise application platform: org.jboss.as.ejb3: jboss enterprise application platform: access restriction bypass via improper ejb method authorization
items.summary: A flaw was found in JBoss Enterprise Application Platform. The processInvocation function within the org.jboss.as.ejb3.security.AuthorizationInterceptor component incorrectly authorizes all requests when no roles are defined for an Enterprise Java Beans (EJB) method invocation. This allows attackers to bypass intended access restrictions for EJB methods, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive functionalities.

items.title: Jboss-eap: aws-ec2: jboss eap and aws ec2: information disclosure via incorrect directory permissions
items.summary: A flaw was found in JBoss Enterprise Application Platform (EAP) and EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI). Incorrect permissions (755) for the /var/cache/jboss-ec2-eap/ directory allow a local user to read sensitive files. This vulnerability can lead to information disclosure, specifically exposing Amazon Web Services (AWS) credentials.

items.title: Rsyslog: rsyslog: improper json escaping in option.json="on" template path for quote-only and backslash-only values
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When processing log entries using certain JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) formatting templates, the service fails to properly escape input composed entirely of quotation marks or backslashes. An attacker who can supply logged input can exploit this issue to generate malformed JSON output, which may cause downstream log ingestion systems and parsers to reject log records.

items.title: Rsyslog: rsyslog: imuxsock buffer underwrite in pid rewriting
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When process identification (PID) rewriting is enabled in the imuxsock module, a local attacker with access to the logging socket can send a crafted log message with an empty tag. This triggers an invalid memory write, causing the logging service to crash and resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

items.title: github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp permits denial of service through a malformed IPv4 payload length
items.summary: In github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp/dhcpv4/nclient4, BroadcastRawUDPConn.ReadFrom does not validate that the IPv4 payload length is sufficient to hold a UDP header before calculating the DHCP payload length. A frame with an IPv4 total-length field specifying fewer than eight payload bytes results in a negative DHCP length, causing a panic in buf.Consume due to a negative slice bound.

items.title: Cakephp twig-view unserialize Twig filter allows arbitrary object deserialization
items.summary: Impact The unserialize filter has no restriction on which classes are allowed. This can be used as a deserialization remote-code-execution gadget. Patches 1.3.3 and 2.1.2 contain a fix for this issue. The fix may impact backwards compatibility if you are relying on deserializing PHP objects in your templates. Workarounds Don't use the unserialize filter.

items.summary: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

items.title: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.summary: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

items.title: Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability

Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.

This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.
